notes.title: Patch 224 & Work Status
notes.notes:
Hey, work on VA is going very slowly. I've had to focus on my job among other things. But we'll get some updates coming soon.

Patch 224 Released
Build Win_VectoredArmada_20240708_1309

- Fixed the first time Default ( Rebel Workbench ) ships not being on the correct team and as such not recolouring at all until saved and reloaded.
( What an annoying first impression for a new player )
- Adjusted the way ships handle threat avoidance to prevent them taking excessively long routes around targets.

notes.title: Patch 223
notes.notes:
Fixed the block delete key (DEL) not working. *facepalm*
Improved the Thruster workbench help info

notes.title: Patch 197-198 : Workbench colour saving fixed. Drones turn better.
notes.notes:
Patch 197-198 released.
Build 20240419

- Fixed Workbench colours not saving and restoring when leaving the workbench / returning to the game.
- Significantly improved the way Drones handle turning. They are hugely less effected by bumping into things and being sent tumbling. As well as using their correct rotation speed.
- Controls are slightly cheaper, after removing the hidden "torquer" feature that was effectively unused and not working correctly.
- Working towards the next mission content release.

notes.title: Patch 182 - Duskfire Regiment overhauled.
notes.notes:
Patch 182 released.
- Duskfire Regiment Overhauled.
- Hail Detachment adjusted.
- Small ships on other missions uparmoured.
- Fixed "Witness" command using the wrong block.
- Energy cost calculations for weapons simplified. ( Cleaner looking numbers )

notes.title: Patch 181 - Menus and Alphabets
notes.notes:
= = =

Bad menus get really annoying really quickly. So - prompted by one particularly irate customer - I have tried to make dealing with the War and Composer in conjunction with the Workbench a lot more pleasant. Let me know what you think.

You could be the next to make VA better! Send feedback!

- - -

Update Patch 177-181
Build 20240405

- War and Composer menus no longer require you to exit out of the selected mission/fleet to transition to a different screen. ( Way less menu nav to get places and do things )
- Fleet ships can now be easily updated to your latest design with the "Update Craftprints" button.
- The Block Palette is now organised hull and utility blocks alphabetically. Weapons and Controls are still grouped according to family.
- New armour block. "Spear Armour"
- Armour Plate renamed to Adapter Armour.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed an oversight with the way local ships are stored, changing your player name will no longer cause saving a ship to not override a previously existant ship with the same name but made with a different player name.
- Misc fixes

= = =

notes.title: Patch 176
notes.notes:
= = =
VA build `Win_VectoredArmada_20240402_1914`
- Fixed an issue causing the Fleet Fight menu to lock up the entire game when Reseting the bench with a ship selected. Weird that I've never done this to myself in months of testing, hah.
- Fixed an issue with the Fleet Composer not correctly counting the amount of ships on Reset, causing it to constantly think there are unsaved changes unless Saved.
- Set the App Icon.
- Disabled HDR force support mode.
- Set a nice background for the initialisation screen.
